news.title: Influentials is back, now for Bluesky
news.html: I revived my Twitter-era influentials visualization for Bluesky: who the IEEE VIS 2026 community follows most, updated every ~15 minutes during the conference. Find yourself in the ranking and follow the top accounts via starter packs.

news.title: At IEEE VIS 2026
news.html: I'm attending IEEE VIS 2026. If you are around, come say hi!

news.title: Papers Navigator for IEEE VIS 2026
news.html: Explore the conference papers by meaning: semantic search, a 2D embedding map, filters, and a personal schedule that tells you which room to go to. A Live page lets you rate talks, take notes and post to Bluesky. Everything stays in your browser.

news.title: Teaching CS 6983: AI Coding (Vibe Coding)
news.html: This fall I'm teaching AI-Assisted Software Engineering in Oakland (hybrid) and Silicon Valley: Claude Code, prompt engineering, agents, MCP and evals.
